units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"No problem. Where will I battle this ship?"|56|0
units.english: "No problem. Where will I battle this ship?"
units.italian: "Nessun problema. Dove combatterò questa nave?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Sorry, I don't think I can agree to that."|57|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't think I can agree to that."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non credo di poter accettare."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"We do most of our starship testing in the <waypoints> system," he says. "The test ship is unmistakable. Journey there, disable it without destroying it, then return here and we'll ask you about any weaknesses you found or improvements you would make. And if you destroy the ship or steal it, naturally you will forfeit your payment."|59|0
units.english: "We do most of our starship testing in the <waypoints> system," he says. "The test ship is unmistakable. Journey there, disable it without destroying it, then return here and we'll ask you about any weaknesses you found or improvements you would make. And if you destroy the ship or steal it, naturally you will forfeit your payment."
units.italian: "Facciamo la maggior parte dei collaudi delle nostre astronavi nel sistema <waypoints>," dice. "La nave da collaudo è inconfondibile. Vai lì, neutralizzala senza distruggerla, poi torna qui e ti chiederemo quali punti deboli hai trovato o quali miglioramenti faresti. E se distruggi la nave o la rubi, naturalmente perderai il pagamento."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|Atinoda meets up with you soon after you land. "I see that you survived," he says. "Was it a difficult fight?"|72|0
units.english: Atinoda meets up with you soon after you land. "I see that you survived," he says. "Was it a difficult fight?"
units.italian: Atinoda ti raggiunge poco dopo che sei atterrato. "Vedo che sei sopravvissuto," dice. "È stata una battaglia difficile?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Yes, you have built an impressive ship."|74|0
units.english: "Yes, you have built an impressive ship."
units.italian: "Sì, hai costruito una nave impressionante."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"No, I'm afraid I made short work of it."|76|0
units.english: "No, I'm afraid I made short work of it."
units.italian: "No, temo che l'abbia liquidata in fretta."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Glad to hear it," he says. "Now, we have the opportunity to make a few tweaks before we start mass-producing this ship. What changes would you recommend?"|80|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it," he says. "Now, we have the opportunity to make a few tweaks before we start mass-producing this ship. What changes would you recommend?"
units.italian: "Mi fa piacere," dice. "Ora abbiamo l'occasione di fare qualche ritocco prima di iniziare a produrre questa nave in serie. Quali cambiamenti consiglieresti?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Oh well," he says, "you are the infamous <first> <last>, after all, so I suppose any single warship will be little threat to you. Now, we have the opportunity to make a few tweaks before we start mass-producing this ship. What changes would you recommend?"|84|0
units.english: "Oh well," he says, "you are the infamous <first> <last>, after all, so I suppose any single warship will be little threat to you. Now, we have the opportunity to make a few tweaks before we start mass-producing this ship. What changes would you recommend?"
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "dopotutto sei il famigerato <first> <last>, quindi suppongo che una singola nave da guerra sia una minaccia minima per te. Ora abbiamo l'occasione di fare qualche ritocco prima di iniziare a produrre questa nave in serie. Quali cambiamenti consiglieresti?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Lots of weapon space is always my first priority."|89|0
units.english: "Lots of weapon space is always my first priority."
units.italian: "Tanto spazio per le armi è sempre la mia prima priorità."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"You should make sure it has enough space for any engine."|91|0
units.english: "You should make sure it has enough space for any engine."
units.italian: "Dovresti assicurarti che ci sia spazio per qualsiasi motore."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Maybe you should work on improving the shields and hull."|93|0
units.english: "Maybe you should work on improving the shields and hull."
units.italian: "Forse dovresti lavorare sul miglioramento di scudi e scafo."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"I feel like such a large ship should have more bays for fighters."|95|0
units.english: "I feel like such a large ship should have more bays for fighters."
units.italian: "Mi sembra che una nave così grande dovrebbe avere più baie di caccia."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Very well," he says, "we'll see if we can expand the weapon capacity so that even the biggest weapons will fit."|101|0
units.english: "Very well," he says, "we'll see if we can expand the weapon capacity so that even the biggest weapons will fit."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice, "vedremo se possiamo ampliare la capacità per le armi, così che ci stiano anche le più grandi."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Very well," he says, "we'll see if we can expand the engine capacity enough that even the biggest engines will fit."|107|0
units.english: "Very well," he says, "we'll see if we can expand the engine capacity enough that even the biggest engines will fit."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice, "vedremo se possiamo ampliare la capacità dei motori abbastanza da farci stare anche i più grandi."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Okay," he says, "we'll focus on strengthening the hull and the shield matrix."|113|0
units.english: "Okay," he says, "we'll focus on strengthening the hull and the shield matrix."
units.italian: "D'accordo," dice, "ci concentreremo sul rafforzare lo scafo e la matrice degli scudi."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Very well," he says, "we'll see if we can incorporate more fighter bays into the hull."|119|0
units.english: "Very well," he says, "we'll see if we can incorporate more fighter bays into the hull."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice, "vedremo se possiamo integrare più baie di caccia nello scafo."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Does the ship model have a name yet?" you ask.|123|0
units.english: "Does the ship model have a name yet?" you ask.
units.italian: "Il modello ha già un nome?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Not yet," he says. "Do you have a suggestion?"|124|0
units.english: "Not yet," he says. "Do you have a suggestion?"
units.italian: "Non ancora," dice. "Hai un suggerimento?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Wraith."|126|0
units.english: "The Wraith."
units.italian: "Il Wraith."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Grey Goose."|128|0
units.english: "The Grey Goose."
units.italian: "La Grey Goose."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Not a bad name, I suppose," he says, "but at Tarazed we usually name our ships after animals. Any other ideas?"|132|0
units.english: "Not a bad name, I suppose," he says, "but at Tarazed we usually name our ships after animals. Any other ideas?"
units.italian: "Non è un brutto nome, suppongo," dice, "ma alla Tarazed di solito diamo alle nostre navi nomi di animali. Altre idee?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Dire Wolf."|134|0
units.english: "The Dire Wolf."
units.italian: "Il Dire Wolf."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Kestrel."|136|0
units.english: "The Kestrel."
units.italian: "La Kestrel."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"I suppose it does sort of look like a goose in flight," he says, "but that's hardly an intimidating name. Do you have any scarier ideas?"|140|0
units.english: "I suppose it does sort of look like a goose in flight," he says, "but that's hardly an intimidating name. Do you have any scarier ideas?"
units.italian: "Suppongo che in volo somigli un po' a un'oca," dice, "ma non è certo un nome che intimorisce. Hai idee più spaventose?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Reaper."|142|0
units.english: "The Reaper."
units.italian: "Il Reaper."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Kestrel."|144|0
units.english: "The Kestrel."
units.italian: "La Kestrel."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"Not bad," he says, "but all our other ships - the Falcon, the Osprey, the Hawk - they're all birds. Maybe a bird name?"|148|0
units.english: "Not bad," he says, "but all our other ships - the Falcon, the Osprey, the Hawk - they're all birds. Maybe a bird name?"
units.italian: "Non male," dice, "ma tutte le nostre altre navi - il Falcon, l'Osprey, il Hawk - sono uccelli. Magari un nome di uccello?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Grey Goose."|150|0
units.english: "The Grey Goose."
units.italian: "La Grey Goose."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Kestrel."|152|0
units.english: "The Kestrel."
units.italian: "La Kestrel."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"I don't know," he says, "that sounds a little bit over the top. Any other suggestions?"|156|0
units.english: "I don't know," he says, "that sounds a little bit over the top. Any other suggestions?"
units.italian: "Non so," dice, "mi sembra un po' troppo. Altri suggerimenti?"

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Wraith."|158|0
units.english: "The Wraith."
units.italian: "Il Wraith."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	"The Kestrel."|160|0
units.english: "The Kestrel."
units.italian: "La Kestrel."

units.id: mission:Kestrel Testing|	When you say the word 'Kestrel' he jerks as if he's just been electrocuted. "Yes," he says, "that's it! That's the name we'll go with. Thank you, Captain. I will let you know as soon as the Kestrel is available for sale, and we will take your recommendations into account when making our final modifications to the design." He pays you two million credits and wishes you the best of luck in your future endeavors.|164|0
units.english: When you say the word 'Kestrel' he jerks as if he's just been electrocuted. "Yes," he says, "that's it! That's the name we'll go with. Thank you, Captain. I will let you know as soon as the Kestrel is available for sale, and we will take your recommendations into account when making our final modifications to the design." He pays you two million credits and wishes you the best of luck in your future endeavors.
units.italian: Quando pronunci la parola 'Kestrel' sussulta come se fosse appena stato folgorato. "Sì," dice, "è quello! È il nome che sceglieremo. Grazie, capitano. Ti farò sapere appena la Kestrel sarà in vendita, e terremo conto dei tuoi consigli quando faremo le modifiche finali al progetto." Ti paga due milioni di crediti e ti augura buona fortuna per le tue future imprese.
